== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of the 7 side (Imperial Troops Have Entered The Base!) of [[The Shield Will Be Down In Moments / Imperial Troops Have Entered The Base! (AI)]] (original, labelled “(AI)”), as published: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/88182de5459f1ffeeb3856f4ece24e2f4c6a7437/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual22-Dark/large/imperialtroopshaveenteredthebase_ai.gif Holotable image repository, commit 88182de] (2 October 2023). Uploaded unchanged (byte-for-byte copy; the PC stores it as PNG data under a .gif name). Replaced at the same address on 20 January 2026 by the “(ALT)” image.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-0/0b/V22-D-imperialtroopshaveenteredthebase_ai-original.png Internet Archive item].
